decision_conditions: The proposal, and the rear and side dormer extensions in particular, by reason of its orientation, design, size, width and the choice of flat roof profile, would form an incongruous addition to the dwelling that would appear box-like and top-heavy on the rear elevation that would be readily visible from the Balmoral Road streetscene and would adversely impact on the character and appearance of the main building, the Balmoral Road streetscene to the south east of the site and the surrounding area, contrary to Policy 28 of the Sutton Local Plan and the guidance in Supplementary Planning Document 'Design of Residential Extensions' (SPD4) and Sutton's Urban Design Guide 'Creating Locally Distinctive Places' SPD (SPD14).

Given the design and the insufficient internal floor to ceiling height of the proposed en-suite bedroom 4, the proposed development would fail to provide an acceptable standard of accommodation for the current and future occupiers as the extensions would not mitigate negative health impacts, such as poor ventilation, overheating, or small space. The proposed development would therefore be contrary to Policy D6 and GG3 of the London Plan 2021 and Policy 9 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.
